Digits through n: n(n+1)/2.

For 4052: n(n+1)/2 ≥ 4052 → n≈89.5. n=89: 89·90/2=4005. n=90: 4095. So the 4052nd digit lies in the block of 90s (positions 4006–4095), and the digit is 9 (first digit of 90).
Positions in the block: 4052−4005=47, the 47th digit of "909090…" (each 90 is two digits, 90 repeated 90 times → 180 digits). Wait: each integer n is written as its digits, repeated n times, so digit counts are not n.

Redo with digit counts: 1–9 contribute 1·n digits each: sum 45 digits. 10–99: each contributes 2n digits. Sum of n for 10..99 = 4950−45 = 4905; digits = 9810. That exceeds 4501, so the positions are within the two-digit range.

After 9: 45 digits. Two-digit number n contributes 2n digits. Cumulative through n: 45 + 2(n(n+1)/2 − 45) = n(n+1) − 45.

For 4501: n(n+1) ≥ 4546 → n=67: 67·68=4556 ≥ 4546; n=66: 66·67=4422, minus 45 = 4377 <4501. So n=67 block covers positions 4378–4511 (4556−45=4511). Position offset: 4501−4377=124, in a block of 134 digits "6767…", even offset → digit 7 (offset 124 is even → second digit, 7).

For 4052: n=63: 63·64=4032−45=3987. n=64: 64·65=4160−45=4115 ≥ 4052. Offset: 4052−3987=65, odd → first digit, 6.

Sum = 7+6 = 13.
